claim: Completion is 87.94% in the test arm (7,903 of 8,987 users) against 88.02% in control (7,933 of 9,013) — the test arm is 0.08 points lower.
Users lost before a doctor replies: 5.30% in the test arm (476 of 8,987) versus 4.74% in control (427 of 9,013), 0.56 points higher in the test arm.
Seven-day follow-up is 12.15% in the test arm (8,891 users with a recorded value) against 12.31% in control (8,923).
Two-proportion z-scores for the test-minus-control gaps are -0.16 for is_completed, 1.72 for lost_before_doctor and -0.32 for followup_7d.
code: df.assign(g=df.group.str.strip()).pipe(lambda t: pd.Series({c: round((t.loc[t.g == '实验组', c].mean() - t.loc[t.g == '对照组', c].mean()) / np.sqrt(t[c].mean() * (1 - t[c].mean()) * (1 / t.loc[t.g == '实验组', c].count() + 1 / t.loc[t.g == '对照组', c].count())), 2) for c in ['is_completed', 'lost_before_doctor', 'followup_7d']}))

claim: In 皮肤科 the test arm lost 191 of 1,503 users before a doctor replied against 124 of 1,618 in control, a two-proportion z-score of 4.67.
code: df.assign(g=df.group.str.strip()).query("department == '皮肤科'").groupby('g').lost_before_doctor.agg(lost='sum', users='count').pipe(lambda t: pd.Series({'test_lost': int(t.loc['实验组', 'lost']), 'test_users': int(t.loc['实验组', 'users']), 'control_lost': int(t.loc['对照组', 'lost']), 'control_users': int(t.loc['对照组', 'users']), 'z_score': round(((t.loc['实验组', 'lost'] / t.loc['实验组', 'users']) - (t.loc['对照组', 'lost'] / t.loc['对照组', 'users'])) / np.sqrt((t.lost.sum() / t.users.sum()) * (1 - t.lost.sum() / t.users.sum()) * (1 / t.users).sum()), 2)}))
